description: A frozen food company specializing in authentic Himalayan-recipe dumplings and momos, sold to hotels, restaurants, and cafes (HORECA) as well as direct to consumers. The founder appeared on a popular cooking reality show. Products are preservative-free with a 4+ month shelf life.

An e-bike rental service designed for gated communities, campuses, and leisure spots like resorts and golf courses. Provides eco-friendly last-mile mobility within private spaces using an app-based booking system.

An education company offering structured brain development courses for children aged 2-12. The curriculum combines cognitive exercises, emotional intelligence training, and logical thinking to boost overall mental development.

A personal hygiene startup offering disposable, biodegradable portable urination devices designed primarily for women. Targets travelers, patients, pregnant women, and anyone needing sanitation solutions on-the-go.

A beverage brand offering natural, preservative-free energy drinks positioned as a healthier alternative in the Indian market. Targets young fitness-conscious consumers looking for a clean-label boost.

A skincare platform that uses diagnostic technology to analyze individual skin types and recommend personalized product routines. Combines dermatological science with data-driven recommendations for customized skincare regimens.

A homemade pickle brand from Bihar bringing traditional family recipes to market. Founded by an elderly couple, the business gained attention for its authentic, small-batch production using generational recipes and local ingredients.
dealNote: No deal in the tank — Namita & Vineeta invested ₹85L after the season aired
